learnRoles.title: Learn Your Role
learnRoles.description: Understanding your role is crucial for success in the game. Each role has unique responsibilities and abilities.

role1.title: Explorer
role1.description: As an explorer, it is your duty to scout the land and find new resources for your settlement. You will often be the first to encounter new challenges and opportunities.

role2.title: HomeGuard
role2.description: As a HomeGuard, your role is to protect your allies from external threats. You will be responsible for fortifying defenses and ensuring the safety of your fellow settlers.

role3.title: Settler
role3.description: As a Settler, your role is to establish and develop your settlement. You will be responsible for gathering resources, building structures, and expanding your territory.
